RFC9830-5-9.note: internal/core/bgp/attribute/rfc9830_test.go::TestRFC9830NoSemanticVerification. Red: require.NoError(ParseTunnelEncap), require.NoError(SubTLVs) with assert.Len(stlvs, 5), assert.Equal(uint32(4242), pref) and the byte-identical round trip, over weight 0, reserved label 3, a SID structure totalling 255, ENLP 99 and an empty segment list.
